Exploring the boundaries of reasoning abilities

Researching intrinsic rewards and proactiveness in models, memory mechanisms, and online learning capabilities.

The Seed Edge is a long-term research program launched by ByteDance Seed team, dedicated to establishing general intelligence. The program focuses on long-term research topics and pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence. We encourage cross-team and cross-modal collaboration. We also provide an open research environment, offer dedicated computing resources, and adopt a longer-term performance review cycle for our members.

The Seed STEM Fellows Program invites 100 outstanding researchers from the forefront of scientific innovation to collaborate with the Seed team on real-world research challenges. Together, we aim to accelerate scientific discovery with AI and advance the frontier of AI intelligence.

Studying how to scalably extract knowledge from massive, ultra-low signal-to-noise ratio multimodal data and unify multimodal generation and understanding.

Exploring hardware-friendly model architectures and training methods and developing models with long-term memory and real-time interaction.

Discovering how to take actions based on visual and speech inputs and utilize various tools in the process flexibly.

Agents exhibit a clear log-sigmoid pattern in environment learning.

  • Core focus

    Possess deep curiosity and a passion for fundamental research.

  • Grand vision

    Have top-tier research capabilities, dare to dream big, and pursue ambitious, high-impact AI challenges.

  • Long-term commitment

    Stay resilient and persistent amid short-term changes, and remain committed to long-term research.

  • Lean, flat, and diverse research team

    Diverse research backgrounds, with small and flat research groups where you can easily propose new topics.

  • Commitment to long-term research

    Extended evaluation cycles with no OKRs or semi-annual reviews, focusing on long-term impact.

  • Independent and sufficient computing resources

    Ample computing resources allocated and managed per research project.

  • Encouragement of cross-modal collaboration

    We encourage cross-team and cross-modal communication and collaboration to promote the interconnection and integration of cross-modal knowledge.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out via : seededge@bytedance.com
